title: Total
qualification: Qualification  Qualifications / Essential Qualifications: B.E./B.Tech./B.Sc (Engg.) – (Civil / Mechanical / Electrical / Instrumentation) or Mechanical/Welding/NDT with ASNT Level-II Certificate (in RT/ UT/ MPT /LPT) with minimum 60% or equivalent CGPI. The specified qualification should have been acquired within the prescribed minimum course duration. Experience: For Grade III – Minimum 9 years post qualification relevant experience (out of which minimum 5 years in Construction Management and Project execution in refinery/ petrochemical/ Cross Country Pipeline). For Grade IV – Minimum 13 years post qualification relevant experience (out of which minimum 5 years in Construction Management and Project execution in refinery/ petrochemical). Desirable: Experience in LNG Port, Offshore & Jetty Project site shall be an added advantage.
age_limit: EIL Recruitment 2026 Age Limit (as on 31-03-2026)  Maximum Age Limit: 41 years for Associate Engineer Grade III positions Maximum Age Limit: 45 years for Associate Engineer Grade IV positions Age relaxations: 10 years for PwD; 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC (NCL), additional for PwD + category; relaxable for Ex-Servicemen as per rules.
selection_process: Screening of online applications and certificates to ascertain eligibility. || Personal Interview for candidates meeting all eligibility criteria.

title: Project Engineer, Technical Officer, Assistant Project Engineer, Senior Artisan
salary: Consolidated Emoluments:Project Engineer on Contract – Rs. 40,000 (1st year), Rs. 45,000 (2nd year), Rs. 50,000 (3rd year), Rs. 55,000 (4th year) plus a one‑time attire allowance of Rs. 8,400 after completion of at least six months; Technical Officer on Contract – Rs. 25,000 (1st year), Rs. 28,000 (2nd year), Rs. 31,000 (3rd & 4th years); Assistant Project Engineer – Rs. 25,506 per month; Senior Artisan – Rs. 23,368 per month, with APE‑C and SA‑C wages revised every six months as per CLC (Central) guidelines.
application_fee: The ECIL Advt. No. 07/2026 walk‑in notification does not prescribe any separate application fee for appearing in the selection process for these contract posts. || Fee Status:Candidates are required to download the application form and attend the walk‑in with documents; there isno mention of any application or examination feein the advertisement, so applicants should not pay any money to unauthorized persons or intermediaries and rely only on official ECIL instructions.
selection_process: Shortlisting & Evaluation:After on‑spot registration and successful verification of original documents, candidates will be evaluated on three components – (A) Qualification: 20% of aggregate percentage scored in BE/B.Tech/Diploma/ITI; (B) Relevant Experience: up to 30 marks based on post‑qualification experience as per post‑specific rules; and (C) Personal Interview: 50 marks. || Final Merit & Offer:Final recommendations will be prepared in order of merit based on total score (A+B+C). Experience from purely academic internships, college projects etc. is not counted. Selected candidates will be engaged on fixed‑tenure contract and must be willing to work anywhere in India as per ECIL’s project requirements.
